# Wan Animate

> > Wan Animate is an AI-powered character animation platform that transforms static images into animated videos using motion transfer and character replacement technology.

The platform centers around Wan 2.2 Animate, an AI video generator that enables users to create character animations from drawings, CG models, and static images. It offers credit-based pricing and supports various animation styles including anime and 3D avatars.

## Key Topics

- Wan 2.2 Animate

- Motion transfer
